name: Healdsburg Plaza

property.ownership_summary: Official City facility page and adopted permit program establish municipal park administration; title and exact perimeter/ROW have not been independently verified.

summary: The City describes the Plaza as a public park with walking, gathering, and community-event uses, supporting a TPF project classification for ordinary park space. Its adopted performance permit rules remain untested; a permit program does not erase the park baseline. Exact surrounding boundaries and event-specific exclusive use remain open.
recording_summary: Ordinary public-place recording and the conditions attached to a performance permit require separate treatment. Resolution 116-2023 includes a commercial-film-permit condition for permit holders; the complete film-permit framework and its reach to ordinary visitors have not been established.
field_items: Document posted park/performance/film signs, the gazebo, ordinary pedestrian paths, and event occupation without inferring a general closure.
Identify municipal sidewalk and curb boundaries separately from park paths, roadways, adjoining businesses, and event footprints.
Preserve current permit criteria and any actual official direction; document the activity, exact location, stated rule, and response.
open_legal_items: Confirm park title/control and perimeter/right-of-way using property records; no APN is assigned from the intersection alone.
Review the two-week lead time, one-performance-per-day cap, one-hour limit, gazebo-only condition, language restrictions, revocation, and appeal under the TPF framework.
Locate the current Film Permit rules and exemptions before treating §3.8.7 as a general visitor filming requirement.
Review current park, solicitation, obstruction, event, and public-property provisions; ordinary filming, leafleting, and criticism are not automatically performances.

subareas.name: Ordinary public park lawns / paths / gathering space

federal.note: Official park, walking, picnic, and community-gathering descriptions fit the traditional public-park baseline under Perry.

california.note: The ordinary public-park facts fit the California framework’s traditional-forum baseline; this is a project classification, not a site-specific court holding.

recording.summary: TPF protection does not alone resolve recording, valid conduct limits, or commercial-permit scope.

restriction_audits.summary: The City requires a permit for Plaza performances, with advance application, time, location, frequency, and conduct conditions. The definition of performance and application to ordinary spontaneous expression require review.
restriction_audits.constitutional_test: Apply the Active California framework to the actual rule, defined area, activity, and enforcement facts; publication alone does not establish validity.

restriction_audits.summary: Performance permit holders are directed not to create commercial recordings without a Healdsburg Film Permit. Whether a separate film policy governs an ordinary visitor, and its scope and validity, remain unresolved.
restriction_audits.constitutional_test: Apply the Active California framework to the actual rule, defined area, activity, and enforcement facts; publication alone does not establish validity.

subareas.name: Surrounding street-side ordinary municipal sidewalk — exact strip pending

federal.note: Ordinary municipal sidewalk doctrine applies to the defined street-side sidewalk, once distinguished from a purpose-built facility approach.

california.note: The ordinary municipal sidewalk receives the traditional public-forum baseline; this is not a classification of every adjoining paved area.

recording.summary: Forum protection and recording analysis remain separate. Identify the lawful street-side vantage before extending this row to a particular position.

restriction_audits.summary: This limited baseline has not established a material restriction for this activity. The local-rule and enforcement sweep is incomplete; this status is not clearance or a finding that no restriction exists.

subareas.notes: No survey-grade boundary or right-of-way edge is established. This row defines the ordinary municipal sidewalk category, not an unmapped forecourt, driveway, or parking area.
